dataset: 512 uniformly sampled official val images; no training augmentation
notes: Coverage checks each GT for an overlapping box, allows one prediction to cover multiple GT, ignores false positives; NOT AP or one-to-one recall.
Raw boxes ignore class and score, hence an optimistic geometry diagnostic.
Assignment uses converged weights in eval mode; does not measure early training or actual gradients.
cap1000 is a read-only postprocessing diagnostic, not a changed experiment setting.
